note: Triennial election of Antrim County Council on the 23 county electoral divisions; nominations received on 17 May 1949, withdrawals to 18 May, and polling on Thursday 2 June 1949 ('POLLING took place yesterday', Belfast News-Letter, 3 June 1949, p. 5). Two divisions were contested, Portrush and Ballycastle; the other 21 members were returned unopposed. No party labels were printed. The outgoing member, A. C. Coyles, was opposed by J. M'Pherson.
